thread.title: Qorvo Plunges on Worries That Broadcom Could Pressure Business

author: thestreet.com
title: Qorvo Plunges on Worries That Broadcom Could Pressure Business

organizations.name: broadcom could pressure business qorvo inc

text:
Qorvo Inc ( QRVO ) stock struggled Thursday, falling 3.92% and closing at $79. At one point, shares were down about 8%.
Investors can thank a "devastating" research note from the analysts at Bank of America/Merrill Lynch, TheStreet's Jim Cramer said on CNBC's "Stop Trading" segment. The analysts cut Qorvo to an underperform rating and assigned an $80 price target, down from their previous target of $85.
Thanks to a renewed interested by Broadcom Ltd ( AVGO ) in the segment, Qorvo's market share in the Apple Inc.'s ( AAPL ) iPhone could be set to decline, the analyst says.
Further, following the Trump administration's decision to block Broadcom's proposed acquisition of Qualcomm, Inc. ( QCOM ) , it leaves many wondering about Broadcom's next move.
"What will Broadcom do?" asked Cramer, who also manages the Action Alerts PLUS charitable trust portfolio .
Nobody knows at this point, but it's unlikely for the company to go down quietly. Will Broadcom come back swinging with a vengeance, taking market share from competitors and pressuring margins? If it can't acquire other companies in the industry, that's what it might have to do instead.
Worth noting is that Broadcom reports earnings on Thursday after the close. As for Qorvo, investors are now worried about the company's future prospects thanks to this research report.
Broadcom and Apple are holdings in Jim Cramer's Action Alerts PLUS Charitable Trust Portfolio . Want to be alerted before Cramer buys or sells AVGO or AAPL? Learn more now.
